scan.rule: while the cursor differs from the end cursor: if the entry key at the cursor is unsigned-less than the threshold, stop at once; else write 0 to entry +0x10 and advance the cursor by 0x20; on reaching the chunk end, take the next chunk base from the next map slot, set the chunk end to base + 0x200, and stop if that base equals the end cursor
stop_rules: an entry key unsigned-less than the threshold
the next chunk base equals the end cursor
scan.writes: only the byte at entry +0x10; no other entry byte and no owner field is written

trailing_bytes: the four bytes after the FDE range, 0x5d52d6c..0x5d52d70, are int3 padding before the next FDE at 0x5d52d70
walk_shape_inference: the cursor / chunk-end / end-cursor / map-slot field layout matches a chunked sequence walk (deque-shaped iterators); recorded as an inference, while the model implements the literal transition rules
